infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MindStep needs camera access so your son can snap photos of homework worksheets.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MindStep needs photo library access to upload worksheets and textbook pages.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MindStep needs microphone access so your son can speak his homework questions directly to Coach Spark.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MindStep to access your photos to inspect homework worksheets.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow MindStep to access your microphone so your son can speak his homework questions directly to Coach Spark.
